title: 第三十四章 再次进入秘境

第三十四章 再次进入秘境-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

这场猎杀一直持续到后半夜，一直到被药剂吸引来的变异怪物全部被杀死之后，爻雪这才将结界彻底关闭，然后对着身后的爻金说道：“你们两个去结界里面将地面的晶核都收集起来吧，尸体全部焚烧干净。”

在得到爻雪的命令之后，爻金和爻木两人分别带着自己的十个复制分身，拿着打扫的工具浩浩荡荡地出发。

他们的动作十分的麻利，将地上掉落的晶核全部收集到一个装着水的容器里面，清洗干净之后，这才被拿到爻雪的面前。

大概过了半个小时之后，爻金的一个复制分身走了过来，身后还跟着两个分身，手里抬着满满一箱子的晶核。

爻雪从来没有见过这么多晶核，看来剩下的异能觉醒药剂所需要的材料有了。

“店长，五个结界里面我们一共清理出了一千三百二十七枚晶核，除此之外，我们还发现了三件异宝。”

说着，爻金的复制分身手上多出了两个圆球一样的东西。

爻雪接过这两样东西，眼前立刻就浮现出了这两样东西的名称以及作用。

【异宝名称：唐刀

异宝等级：一级

异宝作用：能够轻松破开秘境中低阶怪物的防御】

【异宝名称：清凉泉水

异宝等级：二级

异宝作用：将该异宝安置在建筑中，周围的温度始终保持在二十五度，泉水清亮，制作药剂时使用可增加药剂的成功率和品质】

先不管异宝到底是什么东西，当爻雪在看完第二个异宝名字和用处的时候，她整个都忍不住哈哈笑出了声。

这个名叫清凉泉水的异宝简直就是及时雨，她正好需要增加药剂品质的东西，药剂的品质高了，觉醒概率自然也会随之提高。

这样想着，爻雪带着这个异宝朝着商店里面走去。

她并没有选择将这件宝物安置在外面，而是选择将其安置在专门放置药材的仓库里面。

The hunt continued until late at night. After all the mutated monsters attracted by the potion were killed, Yaoxue completely closed the barrier, and then said to Yaojin behind him: "You two go inside the barrier to collect all the crystal nuclei on the ground, and burn all the corpses."

After receiving Yaoxue's order, Yaojin and Yaomu set off with ten copies of themselves and cleaning tools.

They moved very quickly, collecting all the crystal nuclei that fell on the ground into a container filled with water. After cleaning them, they were brought to Yaoxue.

About half an hour later, a clone of Yao Jin came over, followed by two clones, carrying a box full of crystal cores in their hands.

Yaoxue has never seen so many crystal nuclei. It seems that the remaining materials needed for the supernatural awakening potion are available.

"Store manager, we have cleared out a total of 1,327 crystal nuclei in the five barriers. In addition, we also found three rare treasures."

As he spoke, Yaojin's clone had two more ball-like objects on its hands.

Yaoxue took these two things, and the names and functions of these two things immediately appeared in front of her eyes.

[Exotic treasure name: Tang Dao

Exotic treasure level: Level 1

Function of exotic treasure: can easily break through the defense of low-level monsters in the secret realm]

[Exotic treasure name: cool spring water

Exotic treasure level: Level 2

Effect of the exotic treasure: Place this exotic treasure in a building, the surrounding temperature will always be kept at 25 degrees, and the spring water will be clear. Use it when making potions to increase the success rate and quality of the potions]

Regardless of what the exotic treasure was, when Yaoxue read the name and uses of the second exotic treasure, she couldn't help laughing.

This exotic treasure called Cool Spring Water was a timely gift. She just needed something to increase the quality of the potion. When the quality of the potion was high, the probability of awakening would naturally increase.

Thinking like this, Yaoxue walked towards the store with this rare treasure.

She did not choose to place this treasure outside, but chose to place it in a warehouse dedicated to storing medicinal materials.
